name: SBI
message:
We partnered with PDSN Media to enhance our brand visibility and establish a strong presence across Mumbai’s high-footfall metro stations. The team delivered impactful co-branding across key locations, creating an immersive and premium brand experience for daily commuters.

From digital pods and videowalls to strategically placed branding elements, every touchpoint was executed with precision to maximize engagement and recall. The execution was seamless, timely, and perfectly aligned with our brand vision.

PDSN Media’s attention to detail and execution excellence helped us reinforce our market leadership in a highly competitive environment. We look forward to collaborating with them again.
